# Fixture MachineImage and release manifests

We are moving to `MachineImage`, `ClusterRelease` and `NodePoolRelease` custom
resources (CRDs) in place of the `osProfiles` files. The move is in progress:
these manifests are generated here to replace the files under
`../profiles/osProfiles` later, and CWE does not read them yet.

Generated by `make fixture-releases` from `../profiles/osProfiles`: one
`MachineImage`, one `ClusterRelease` and one `NodePoolRelease` per OS profile.
Do not edit by hand: `go test ./hack/osprofiles-to-crs` fails when this
directory is not an exact regeneration.
